source.dataset: HHS COVID-19 Reported Patient Impact and Hospital Capacity by Facility (weekly)
source.release: series ends 2024-04-21 (hospital reporting to HHS stopped being mandatory after 2024-04-30); 214 weeks on file from 2020-03-22
source.filter: hospital_pk == '330024', ordered by collection_week; capacity summary over the last 52 weeks on file, ED-visit summary over the last 52 weeks that have a value; -999999 (suppressed) treated as missing
source.note: The dataset has no all-cause admissions field (only COVID-19 and influenza admissions). Occupancy = beds used / beds, both 7-day averages. 'inpatient_beds' includes all staffed inpatient beds (adult and pediatric); definitions follow the HHS reporting guidance and differ from the cost report's 'beds available'.
